_doc: Keys and value types of the Stop hook payloads recorded in one real run each on 2026-10-13 (Claude Code
2.1.x, codex-cli 0.160.1; docs/specs/shared-rules/SPEC.md D6); values are synthetic.  A main-session Stop
carries no agent_id.  Claude names the turn `prompt_id`, Codex `turn_id`.  stop_hook_active is a boolean on
both hosts (false on a first Stop).  Not measured: the payload of a Stop that follows a block (the host
documents stop_hook_active as true there), and how Claude Code treats the block output below.
tests/test_shoal_guard.py feeds payloads built from these shapes to adapt_claude / adapt_codex.
